title: TRON configuration: limits.yaml
description: Risk/exposure/drawdown limit STRUCTURE, per PID §13's checked-limit items (account exposure, instrument exposure, drawdown, daily loss, position count, order size, consecutive-loss policy) and enforced at the ACCOUNT AND RISK LIMITS check stage (PID §12 stage 4). All numeric values in config.example/limits.yaml are ILLUSTRATIVE PLACEHOLDERS ONLY — real limit values are not decided by WO-TRON-D1. This schema also holds on_hard_limit_breach, which represents DEC-OPEN-03 (response to hard-limit breach) as an OPEN, currently-PROPOSED policy, not a decided requirement — see 07-CONFIGURATION.md and 11-DECISIONS.md. Contract-owner of this file: WI-D (WO-TRON-D1). The specific checks that consume these values (e.g. exactly how 'account exposure' is computed) are owned by 06-CHECKS-CATALOGUE.md (WI-C); this file only supplies the configured numeric ceilings and policy selection.

instrument_name.description: Instrument identifier string, consistent with mapping.schema.json's canonical_instrument keys.

nonnegative_decimal_string.description: Exact non-negative decimal representation (HR-05). Never a binary float. Upper-bound/range constraints beyond non-negativity (e.g. a percentage's <=100 bound) are not expressible as a JSON Schema pattern for an arbitrary-precision decimal string and are deferred to the semantic-validate pipeline stage (07-CONFIGURATION.md §2), not this schema.

config_schema_version.description: Configuration schema major version for this file. Must equal "1". See 07-CONFIGURATION.md §2.

max_account_exposure.description: Configured ceiling on account-level exposure. Unit and precise computation are defined by the consuming check ('Current gross exposure checked' / 'Projected gross exposure checked' etc., 06-CHECKS-CATALOGUE.md, WI-C); this field only supplies the configured numeric ceiling.

max_instrument_exposure.description: Map keyed by canonical_instrument to a configured per-instrument exposure ceiling ('Instrument exposure checked', PID §13). Absent means no per-instrument exposure ceiling beyond default_max_instrument_exposure (if present) or max_account_exposure applies.

default_max_instrument_exposure.description: Fallback per-instrument exposure ceiling for a canonical instrument with no explicit entry in max_instrument_exposure. Absent means no per-instrument default is configured beyond max_account_exposure.

max_drawdown_pct.description: Configured maximum account drawdown, expressed as a decimal-string percentage (e.g. "10.00" means 10.00%). An upper bound of 100 is a semantic-validate concern (see nonnegative_decimal_string note), not enforced by this schema pattern.

max_daily_loss.description: Configured ceiling on daily realised+unrealised loss ('Daily loss limit checked', PID §13).

max_position_count.description: Configured ceiling on the total number of concurrently open positions across the account ('Position count checked', PID §13).

max_order_size.description: Map keyed by canonical_instrument to a configured per-instrument maximum order size ('Maximum order size checked', PID §13). Absent means no per-instrument order-size ceiling beyond default_max_order_size (if present) is configured for that instrument.

default_max_order_size.description: Fallback maximum order size for a canonical instrument with no explicit entry in max_order_size. Absent means no per-instrument default order-size ceiling is configured.

max_consecutive_losses.description: Configured threshold ('Consecutive loss count checked', PID §13). Reaching this many consecutive losing trades is treated as a hard-limit condition subject to on_hard_limit_breach.

on_hard_limit_breach.description: Configured response when a hard account-level limit (including consecutive_loss_policy.max_consecutive_losses) is breached. 'block_new_risk' corresponds to DEC-OPEN-03's currently PROPOSED MVP (block new risk; existing positions remain protected by their broker-side SL/TP) — it is not a decided requirement. 'flatten_all_positions' is named here only so this schema does not foreclose a different eventual Product Authority answer; adding a further named response later is an additive, non-breaking change under this file's config_schema_version.
